_read_me: The site's own settings for each product - everything else about a product comes from the Master Product & Pricing Sheet (tools/catalog/export.ps1 -> sheet.json -> tools/catalog/sync.mjs). slugs: a product whose web address is not its name without 'DS ' (lower case, spaces to hyphens). isNew: the products' 'new' flag. markNew: shows 'New' beside the name on the shelves and in the vault. whop: each Free Vault tool's Whop listing (the part of its whop.com/dsuniverse/products/<listing>/ address) and checkout plan; a free tool with no plan here shows 'Opening soon' instead of Download. Add a link with: node tools/catalog/whop.mjs <slug> <checkout link> [listing link].
